glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 耳 (“ear”) + 又 (“hand”) - to take the ear of fallen prey, a rite of hunters mentioned in the Rites of Zhou. 「大獸公之，小禽私之，獲者取左耳。」 Shuowen interprets it as taking the ear of an enemy instead. However, Wang (2022) points out that there is no evidence that this actually happened in war.
shuowen: 「大獸公之，小禽私之，獲者取左耳。」 Shuowen interprets it as taking the ear of an enemy instead.
senses: (Xiamen, Quanzhou, &, Taiwan Hokkien) to redeem (from mortgage, pawn, etc.)
